verses.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος εἴ τις ἐπισκοπῆς ὀρέγεται καλοῦ ἔργου ἐπιθυμεῖ
verses.transliteration: Pistos ho logos ei tis episkopēs oregetai kalou ergou epithymei
verses.literal: This is a trustworthy saying If anyone aspires to be an overseer he desires a noble task
verses.literalPt: Fiel é esta palavra: se alguém aspira ao episcopado, deseja uma obra boa.

verses.original: δεῖ οὖν τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνεπίλημπτον εἶναι μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρα νηφάλιον σώφρονα κόσμιον φιλόξενον διδακτικόν
verses.transliteration: dei oun ton episkopon anepilēmpton einai mias gynaikos andra nēphalion sōphrona kosmion philoxenon didaktikon
verses.literal: An overseer then must be above reproach the husband of but one wife temperate self-controlled respectable hospitable able to teach
verses.literalPt: É necessário, pois, que o bispo seja irrepreensível, esposo de uma só mulher, discreto, sóbrio, circunspecto, hospitaleiro, capaz de ensinar,

verses.original: μὴ πάροινον μὴ πλήκτην ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ ἄμαχον ἀφιλάργυρον
verses.transliteration: mē paroinon mē plēktēn alla epieikē amachon aphilargyron
verses.literal: not dependent on wine not violent but gentle peaceable and free of the love of money
verses.literalPt: não dado ao vinho, não espancador, mas moderado, inimigo de contendas, não cobiçoso

verses.original: τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς προϊστάμενον τέκνα ἔχοντα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος
verses.transliteration: tou idiou oikou kalōs proistamenon tekna echonta en hypotagē meta pasēs semnotētos
verses.literal: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control with complete dignity
verses.literalPt: e que saiba governar bem a sua casa, tendo seus filhos em sujeição, com todo o respeito

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου προστῆναι οὐκ οἶδεν πῶς ἐκκλησίας Θεοῦ ἐπιμελήσεται
verses.transliteration: ei de tis tou idiou oikou prostēnai ouk oiden pōs ekklēsias Theou epimelēsetai
verses.literal: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household how can he care for the church of God
verses.literalPt: (se um homem não sabe governar a sua casa, como cuidará da igreja de Deus?);

verses.original: μὴ νεόφυτον ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: mē neophyton hina mē typhōtheis eis krima empesē tou diabolou
verses.literal: He must not be a recent convert or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil
verses.literalPt: não neófito, para que não suceda que, inchado de soberba, caia na condenação do Diabo.

verses.original: δεῖ δὲ καὶ μαρτυρίαν καλὴν ἔχειν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν ἵνα μὴ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμπέσῃ καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου
verses.transliteration: dei de kai martyrian kalēn echein apo tōn exōthen hina mē eis oneidismon empesē kai pagida tou diabolou
verses.literal: Furthermore . . . he must have a good reputation with outsiders so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil
verses.literalPt: É necessário que ele tenha bom testemunho dos que são de fora, para que não caia no opróbrio e no laço do Diabo.

verses.original: Διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς μὴ διλόγους μὴ οἴνῳ πολλῷ προσέχοντας μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς
verses.transliteration: Diakonous hōsautōs semnous mē dilogous mē oinō pollō prosechontas mē aischrokerdeis
verses.literal: Deacons likewise must be dignified not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money
verses.literalPt: Os diáconos sejam também sérios, não dobres em palavras, nem dados ao vinho, nem amigos de sórdidas ganâncias,

verses.original: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει
verses.transliteration: echontas to mystērion tēs pisteōs en kathara syneidēsei
verses.literal: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience
verses.literalPt: conservando o mistério da fé em uma consciência pura.

verses.original: καὶ οὗτοι δὲ δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον εἶτα διακονείτωσαν ἀνέγκλητοι ὄντες
verses.transliteration: kai houtoi de dokimazesthōsan prōton eita diakoneitōsan anenklētoi ontes
verses.literal: Additionally . . . they must first be tested . . . Then if they are above reproach let them serve as deacons
verses.literalPt: Também estes sejam primeiro provados; depois, exercitem o diaconato, se forem inculpáveis.

verses.original: Γυναῖκας ὡσαύτως σεμνάς μὴ διαβόλους νηφαλίους πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: Gynaikas hōsautōs semnas mē diabolous nēphalious pistas en pasin
verses.literal: In the same way the women must be dignified not slanderers but temperate and faithful in all things
verses.literalPt: As mulheres também devem ser sérias, não maldizentes, sóbrias, fiéis em tudo.

verses.original: Διάκονοι ἔστωσαν μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρες τέκνων καλῶς προϊστάμενοι καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων
verses.transliteration: Diakonoi estōsan mias gynaikos andres teknōn kalōs proistamenoi kai tōn idiōn oikōn
verses.literal: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife a good manager of his children and of his own household
verses.literalPt: Os diáconos devem ser esposos de uma só mulher, que governem bem a seus filhos e as suas casas.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ καλῶς διακονήσαντες βαθμὸν ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν περιποιοῦνται καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoi gar kalōs diakonēsantes bathmon heautois kalon peripoiountai kai pollēn parrēsian en pistei tē en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Pois os que houverem exercitado bem o seu diaconato alcançarão para si um lugar honroso e muita confiança na fé que é em Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Ταῦτά σοι γράφω ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐν τάχει
verses.transliteration: Tauta soi graphō elpizōn elthein pros se en tachei
verses.literal: Although I hope to come to you soon I am writing you these things
verses.literalPt: Essas coisas te escrevo, ainda que espero em breve ir ter convosco;

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ βραδύνω ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἐν οἴκῳ Θεοῦ ἀναστρέφεσθαι ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία Θεοῦ ζῶντος στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: ean de bradynō hina eidēs pōs dei en oikō Theou anastrephesthai hētis estin ekklēsia Theou zōntos stylos kai hedraiōma tēs alētheias
verses.literal: in case I am delayed so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household which is the church of the living God the pillar and foundation of the truth
verses.literalPt: mas, se eu tardar, para que saibas como se deve proceder na casa de Deus, a qual é a Igreja do Deus vivo, coluna e apoio da verdade.

verses.original: Καὶ ὁμολογουμένως μέγα ἐστὶν τὸ τῆς εὐσεβείας μυστήριον Ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai homologoumenōs mega estin to tēs eusebeias mystērion Hos ephanerōthē en sarki edikaiōthē en pneumati ōphthē angelois ekērychthē en ethnesin episteuthē en kosmō anelēmphthē en doxē
verses.literal: By common confession the mystery of godliness is great He appeared in the flesh was vindicated by the Spirit was seen by angels was proclaimed among the nations was believed in throughout the world was taken up in glory
verses.literalPt: Sem dúvida, grande é o mistério da piedade: Aquele que se manifestou em carne foi justificado no espírito, foi visto dos anjos, pregado entre as nações, crido no mundo e recebido na glória.
